fieldsPreview.Company Overview: Remington Hospitality CALA is the Caribbean and Latin America division of Remington Hospitality, a U.S.-based third-party hotel management company founded in 1968. Following a strategic expansion into CALA in late 2022, Remington established a regional headquarters in Miami to support owners and asset managers across Costa Rica, Mexico, Puerto Rico, the Cayman Islands, Belize, Panama, Peru, and the Dominican Republic. The CALA portfolio includes existing and pipeline full-service, lifestyle, and resort properties under brands such as Kimpton, Hilton Garden Inn, Moxy, Autograph Collection, and LXR.
